The '''A1-R0 Weather Monitor Probe''' was a type of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] used by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The A1-R0 Probe was used to monitor the surface weather of the planet at surface installations such as the upper section of [[Genetics Laboratory G-1]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The A1-R0 Weather Monitor Probe appears as a NPC in the Tactical Flashpoint "Depths of Manaan," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.9: Galactic Strongholds Early Access.<ref name="TOR" />
